.@elonmusk: "You don't need college learning."

• You can learn almost anything you want for free.
• The internet has made knowledge widely accessible.
• College can still have value as a way to demonstrate discipline and the ability to complete difficult assignments.
• It also gives young people a chance to spend time with others their age before entering the workforce.

"Colleges are basically for fun and to prove you can do your chores, but they're not for learning."

Elon Musk: "Tesla recruiting does not have anything that says 'requires university' because that's absurd."

Instead, Musk says Tesla looks for evidence of exceptional ability.

• A college degree is not considered proof of exceptional ability.
• Candidates should demonstrate that they've actually done something exceptional.
• Musk points to successful people who dropped out of college as examples that a degree isn't required for exceptional achievement.
• What matters is ability, results, and evidence of doing something extraordinary.

At Tesla, the focus is on what you can do, not simply where you studied.
